auth.withMicrosoft: Use the Microsoft 365 account you already sign in to email with. SUPSERV keeps no password of its own.
auth.failed: Sign-in did not complete. Nothing was changed — try again.
auth.noAccountHelp: Only accounts in the SUPSERV directory can sign in. If yours is refused, ask the Gérant to add you.
auth.noRoleTitle: Your account works, but you have no access yet
auth.noRoleBody: You are signed in as {email}. The Gérant decides what each person may do, and has not assigned you a role. Nothing is broken — ask them to open Settings → Users and roles.

profile.title: My profile
profile.subtitle: Settings that follow you, not the company.
profile.interfaceLanguageHelp: This changes what YOU see. It does not change the language of any document or email — those follow the client or supplier they are addressed to.
profile.documentLanguageHelp: Set on each company, not here. A French client receives French paperwork even when you work in English.

filters.stageHint: More than one value allowed — OR inside a field
filters.ownerHint: AND between fields, OR inside one

views.closingThisWeekAsks: Deadline inside 7 days, not won or lost
views.waitingOnSupplierAsks: Asked, no reply, 2 days or more
views.nothingSentYetAsks: Enquiry open, no offer, older than 3 days

search.title: Search
search.prompt: Companies, contacts, items and references. Spelling does not have to be exact.
search.noneBody: Try fewer words, or part of a name. If a company is known here by another spelling, add it as an alias on its page and every future search will find it.

company.newSubtitle: Only the legal name and one role are required. The rest can follow.
company.identityHelp: The name on their paperwork, and what they are to us.
company.tradeNameHint: If they are known by something shorter. Saved as an alias so search finds it.
company.rolesHint: A company can be both a client and a supplier. The first one chosen sets the code.
company.legalIdentityHelp: Décret 05-468 requires the client's NIF on an invoice, alongside our own RC, NIF, NIS and article d'imposition. Leave them empty now if you do not have them — the invoice will say what is missing when the time comes.
company.docLocaleHelp: Documents and email follow the COMPANY, not the person writing. Set French here and this client receives French paperwork even when an English-speaking colleague produces it.
company.aliasHelp: Every spelling anyone has used. Search matches all of them, and a merge adds the retired company's names here.
company.noContacts: Nobody recorded at this company yet.

empty.noCompaniesBody: Companies arrive when you add one, or when an email from a new sender is filed against a new record.
empty.noDealsBody: Deals appear here when you create one, or when an email in the Inbox is turned into one.
empty.errorBody: The server did not respond. Nothing was changed.
empty.noPermissionTitle: You do not have access to cost and margin
empty.noPermissionBody: The rest of this offer is visible. Ask the Gérant for {permission}.

invoice.companyIdentityIncomplete: Company identity is incomplete — RC, NIF, NIS or article d'imposition
invoice.vatServicesAbroad: VAT on services rendered abroad not confirmed

rules.unconfirmed: This rule has not been confirmed yet. It warns rather than blocks.
